title: Monograph 26: Pharmacopoeial Botanical Standard Entry
authority: Pharmacopoeia Commission for Indian Medicine & Homoeopathy (PCIM&H), Ministry of AYUSH
publisher: Pharmacopoeia Commission for Indian Medicine & Homoeopathy (PCIM&H)
content: Official Ayurvedic Pharmacopoeia of India (API) Monograph Standard #26. Establishes macro-microscopic identity, foreign organic matter limit (NMT 2%), total ash (NMT 8%), acid-insoluble ash (NMT 1.5%), alcohol-soluble extractive (NLT 10%), heavy metal safety thresholds (Lead <= 10ppm, Arsenic <= 3ppm, Cadmium <= 0.3ppm, Mercury <= 1ppm), and TKDL prior art indexing under the First Schedule of Drugs and Cosmetics Act, 1940.
